body:
"Milhaus" wrote in message ...
>Read "Mirror Worlds" by David Gelernter instead.
>
>He was one of unabomber's targets and he specifically mentioned the book
>in letter which accompanied the bomb.  BTW, Gelernter survived the
>blast.
>
>Here's an example of unabomber's writing....
>
>Dr. Gelernter:
>
>People with advanced degrees aren't as smart as they think they are. If
>you'd had any brains you would have realized that there are a lot of
>people out there who resent bitterly the way techno-nerds like you are
>changing the world and you wouldn't have been dumb enough to open an
>unexpected package from an unknown source.
>
>
>.....
>
>So, you can either read the ranting of a madman by following the links
>below, or you could read that which he sought to destroy

The letter to Dr. Gerlernter is hilarious!

The Unabomber is not a madman.  He is actually more sane than most people.
His reason for killing is perfectly logical as he makes clear in Paragraph
96 of the Manifesto:

   "In order to get our message before the public with some chance of
    making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."

I encourage everyone to read his essay, he makes incredibly persuasive
arguments for the destruction of technological/industrial society.
